children: YETI unveiled a long-term growth strategy and financial framework at its 2026 Investor Day, targeting $1.2–$1.4 billion cumulative free cash flow through fiscal 2030.
Announced four priorities: create next $1B of sales, build next $1B product platform, $1B international sales, and >$1B cumulative FCF.
Long-term financial targets to FY2030: mid- to high-single-digit sales growth and $1.2–$1.4B cumulative free cash flow.
Annual growth goals: high-single- to low-double-digit adjusted operating income; low-double-digit to high-teens adjusted EPS growth.
Project Upcycle aims to identify ~$100M of productivity savings across COGS and operating expenses to fund growth and margin expansion.
Reiterated Fiscal 2026 outlook: sales +7%–8%, adjusted operating income growth 10%–12%, adjusted EPS $2.94–$3.00, FCF $200M–$225M.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: YETI Unveils 2030 Financial Framework, Targets $1.2–$1.4B Cumulative FCF
